response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years of experience across many languages and domains, but his background shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal role. His trajectory is generalist product/web/embedded engineering rather than large-scale, multi-team platform ownership at the IC6/Principal level, and there's no indication of experience influencing cross-functional Product/Data Science/Research stakeholders around measurable growth outcomes.
strengths: Broad, deep technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming (C, C++, C#, Java, JS/TS, DLang)
Long tenure and demonstrated technical leadership (Staff/Senior titles) across multiple companies
Active open-source contributor and technical educator/speaker, showing strong engineering craftsmanship and communication skills
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or A/B testing infrastructure
No evidence of telemetry/metrics platform work or data-driven growth engineering
Career pattern shows individual project ownership rather than cross-team platform leadership at enterprise/Principal scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering breadth and seniority
